A '''star system''' was located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the [[Avenel Rest Station]].<ref name="Gundark" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star/Legends|star]] system containing the Avenel Rest Station was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square O-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
